description: Creditor enrollment in a yobel rite. The creditor voluntarily attests to a portfolio of `debts[]` they are willing to forgive under the declared rite. Per CLAUDE.md `Schema invariant`: `debts[]` is a HISTORICAL RECORD ONLY — this lexicon provides NO method to mutate or augment debts after enrollment (append-only MST + schema constraint together enforce one-way forgiveness). ERC725 EIP-712 signedConsent verifies the creditor's voluntary intent. Per ADR-2605201800.

riteId.description: Parent declareRite.riteId this enrollment belongs to.

debts.description: Historical-record debt portfolio. APPEND-ONLY — no schema method to mutate; subsequent enrollments by the same creditor under the same riteId are explicitly REJECTED (the audit_witness cell halts on enrollmentId duplicate-creditor-per-rite).

totalPledgedReleaseMicroUsdc.description: Sum of debts[].principalMicroUsdc + accruedMicroUsdc this creditor pledges to release. Validator enforces ≤ Σ debts[].

erc725SignedConsent.description: EIP-712 signed consent verifying the creditor's voluntary intent. Per CLAUDE.md `Eligibility` row + ADR-2605201800.

voluntaryAttestation.description: Structural: creditor MUST attest voluntary participation. The schema rejects involuntary enrollment (Charter Rider §2(a) anti-coercion).

couldRedeemAt.description: Optional creditor-self-declared cooling-off / redemption deadline. Per ADR-2605201800 §voluntary-redemption (if any).

principalMicroUsdc.description: Principal debt in micro-USDC (USDC × 10^6, integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900).

accruedMicroUsdc.description: Pre-existing accrued interest / fees in micro-USDC. Historical record; no method to grow this value via yobel substrate.

debtorHandleHash.description: Optional sha256 hash of the debtor's identifier (privacy-preserving — actual DID resolution happens at enrollDebtor).

smartWalletAddress.description: ERC725 Smart Wallet address of the creditor.

eip712TypedDataHash.description: EIP-712 typed-data hash signed (over enrollmentId + riteId + totalPledgedReleaseMicroUsdc).
